# bintables/mod

> % : signed remainder with `idiv` (remainder from rdx).

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/mod.pkg) · translates [std/mod](../std/mod.md)

Same as `div`, then moves the remainder from `rdx` into `rax`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when right simple`

```nasm
{left}
mov rbx, {right.operand}
cqo
idiv rbx
mov rax, rdx
```

### `emit`

```nasm
@binop
cqo
idiv rbx
mov rax, rdx
```

Includes: [bintables/binop](binop.md)
